svg.title: Leandro Bertalhia's stack as a staircase, from the database to the screen, on the platform that ships them: PostgreSQL, Prisma and Drizzle; NestJS, tRPC and TypeScript; Next.js, React, Expo and SwiftUI; on Docker, GitHub Actions, Cloudflare and AWS.
